injuries.name: Jordan Battle
injuries.detail: Battle finished Sunday's 38-18 win over Pittsburgh with six tackles (four solo), one defensed pass and one forced fumble.

injuries.name: Demetrius Knight Jr.
injuries.detail: Knight finished with eight tackles (six solo) and a defensed pass against the Steelers in a 38-18 victory Sunday.

injuries.name: Barrett Carter
injuries.detail: Carter posted six tackles (two solo) and a defensed pass in Sunday's 38-18 win over Pittsburgh.

injuries.name: Drew Sample
injuries.detail: Sample caught all three of his targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win against Pittsburgh.

injuries.name: Kyle Dugger
injuries.detail: questionable

injuries.name: Myles Hinton
injuries.detail: questionable

injuries.name: Evan McPherson
injuries.detail: McPherson made one of his two field-goal attempts and all five PATs in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Dohnte Meyers
injuries.detail: Meyers caught both of his targets for 20 yards and a touchdown while also adding 58 yards as a kick returner during Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.

injuries.name: Tee Higgins
injuries.detail: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said that Higgins was held out late in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Steelers for workload-management purposes, Kelsey Conway of The Cincinnati Enquirer reports.

injuries.name: Samaje Perine
injuries.detail: Perine turned six carries into 14 yards and a touchdown and hauled in all four of his targets for 25 yards during the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Tahj Brooks
injuries.detail: Brooks carried three times for 12 yards while taking the field for three of the Bengals' 66 offensive snaps in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Steelers.

injuries.name: Mike Gesicki
injuries.detail: Gesicki caught one pass for nine yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.

injuries.name: Chase Brown
injuries.detail: Brown rushed 10 times for 44 yards and brought in eight of nine targets for 39 yards for two touchdowns in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Ja'Marr Chase
injuries.detail: Chase brought in 11 of 14 targets for 231 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Cincinnati.

injuries.name: Joe Burrow
injuries.detail: Burrow completed 35 of 44 passes for 409 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added one rush for eight yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night.

injuries.name: Oren Burks
injuries.detail: Burks (groin) will not return to Sunday night's game against the Steelers, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Dalton Risner
injuries.detail: Risner (knee) will not return to Sunday night's game against the Steelers.

injuries.name: Andrei Iosivas
injuries.detail: Iosivas (thumb) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

injuries.name: DJ Turner II
injuries.detail: Turner (ankle) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

injuries.name: Brian Parker II
injuries.detail: The Bengals opened Parker's (undisclosed) 21-day practice window Thursday.

injuries.name: Jalen Davis
injuries.detail: The Bengals designated Davis (hamstring) to return from injured reserve Thursday.

injuries.name: Bryan Cook
injuries.detail: Cook registered 10 tackles (five solo) during the Bengals' win over the Falcons on Sunday.
